summary:
The Associated Press publishes at apnews.com. The “AP” mark in the tab is the favicon for wire stories on that host, distinct from member newspapers.

Checked 12 November 2026 against apnews.com. HTML came from https://apnews.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://apnews.com/favicon.ico returned png (16×16, 273 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://apnews.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #000000 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 3239 bytes) from https://apnews.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
